title: 第009章 全员追捧拥奶师，堂兄妒火起邪心
content_zh:
赵虎五人被罚清扫山道、苦修戒训的消息，如风一般席卷了整个清风宗外门。

    短短一个上午，所有外门弟子全都知晓了这件轰动全外门的大事。

    往日里横行霸道、无人敢惹的外门恶霸团伙。

    被新晋入门、人人以为是废柴软柿子的蔡小姬，一人轻松团控制服。

    还被管事当众重罚，彻底打掉了所有嚣张气焰。

    这一波反转，直接震碎了所有弟子的固有认知。

    所有人对蔡文姬的印象，彻底被颠覆重塑。

    从前，众人眼里的她：残缺废灵根、走旁门左道、只能疗伤的弱鸡新人。

    现在，众人眼里的她：能愈能控、反手制裁恶霸、深藏不露的音律大佬。

    外门彻底炸开了锅。

    演武场上、膳食堂中、弟子院落里，处处都在议论她的名字。

    “谁能想到啊！蔡师妹看着软萌乖巧，出手居然这么利落！”

    “哪里是利落，是公道！赵虎那群人欺压我们这么久，终于有人治他们了！”

    “以前只觉得她是个只会治伤的软柿子，现在才知道，人家是真正隐藏大佬！”

    “疗伤本事天下无双也就罢了，控场之术更是无人能破，这简直是战场上的定海神针！”

    修仙界最吃香的是什么？

    不是只会莽的蛮力修士，而是能保人、能救人、能控场、能翻盘的辅助强者。

    尤其是清风宗这种三流小宗门，资源匮乏、丹药稀缺、疗伤手段几乎为零。

    蔡文姬的存在，直接拉高了整个外门的生存质量。

    从前弟子历练受伤、修炼暗伤、心魔躁动，只能硬生生熬着、扛着。

    熬不过的，境界停滞、修为倒退、终身报废。

    现在，只要找蔡师妹听一曲琴音，百病消、淤塞通、心神宁。

    效果碾压所有低阶疗伤丹！

    一时间，外门弟子彻底开启全员抱大腿模式。

    清晨天刚亮，蔡文姬的院门外就排起了长长的队伍。

    有昨日受过恩惠、专程来送灵米的温和师兄。

    有带着自制山野鲜果、只求微调一下修炼状态的师妹。

    还有平日里独来独往、高冷寡言的苦修弟子，也厚着脸皮排在队尾。

    只求蹭一波音律灵气，抚平常年苦修留下的经脉裂痕。

    峡谷里抢着护她的是队友。

    修真界抢着讨好她的是全宗门同门。

    蔡文姬看着院门外长长队伍，无奈又好笑地叹了口气。

    她真的只是想安安静静苟发育、攒功德、慢慢升级。
content_en:
The news that Zhao Hu and the other five were punished to clean the mountain roads and undergo hard training swept through the outer sect of Qingfeng Sect like the wind.

    In just one morning, all the outer sect disciples knew about this major event that shocked the entire outer sect.

    In the past, the gang of outer sect bullies ran rampant and no one dared to mess with them.

    Cai Xiaoji, who was newly promoted and thought to be a loser, easily controlled the team by herself.

    He was also severely punished by the steward in public, which completely destroyed all his arrogance.

    This reversal directly shattered the inherent cognition of all disciples.

    Everyone's impression of Cai Wenji has been completely overturned and reshaped.

    In the past, everyone saw her as a weak newbie with a broken spiritual root, a side path, and could only heal her wounds.

    Now, in the eyes of everyone, she is a music master who can control herself more and more, punish bullies with backhand, and hide her secrets.

    The outer door completely exploded.

    Her name was discussed everywhere in the martial arts arena, in the dining hall, and in the disciples' courtyard.

    "Who would have thought! Junior sister Cai looks so cute and well-behaved, but she can strike so neatly!"

    "What's more, it's fairness! Zhao Hu's group of people have oppressed us for so long, and finally someone has punished them!"

    "I used to think she was a soft persimmon who could only heal wounds, but now I know she is the real hidden boss!"

    "My ability to heal wounds is unparalleled in the world, and my ability to control the field is even more unbreakable. This is simply the sea-fixing needle on the battlefield!"

    What is the most popular thing in the world of immortality?

    Not a brute force monk who only knows how to be reckless, but a strong support person who can protect people, save people, control the field, and turn the tables.

    Especially for third-rate small sects like Qingfeng Sect, there are few resources, elixirs are scarce, and healing methods are almost zero.

    Cai Wenji's existence directly improved the quality of life of the entire outer sect.

    In the past, disciples were injured through experience, secretly injured during practice, and had inner demons, so they could only endure it and carry it on.

    Those who cannot survive it will have their realm stagnated, their cultivation will regress, and they will be scrapped for life.

    Now, as long as I listen to Junior Sister Cai's piano music, all diseases will disappear, congestion will be relieved, and my mind will be at peace.

    The effect crushes all low-level healing pills!

    For a moment, the outer disciples completely started hugging each other.

    At dawn in the morning, a long queue formed outside Cai Wenji's courtyard.

    There is Senior Brother Wen who received a favor yesterday and made a special trip to deliver spiritual rice.

    There are junior sisters who bring home-made fresh fruits from the wild and just want to fine-tune their cultivation state.

    There are also ascetic disciples who usually live alone and are aloof and taciturn, but they also shamelessly line up at the end of the queue.

    I just want a wave of rhythmic spiritual energy to heal the cracks in my meridians left by years of hard practice.

    It was her teammates who were rushing to protect her in the canyon.

    In the world of cultivation, the whole sect is scrambling to please her.

    Cai Wenji looked at the long queue outside the courtyard gate and sighed helplessly and amusedly.

    She really just wants to develop quietly, accumulate merit, and slowly level up.
title_en: Chapter 009 Everyone is following the breast-hugging master, and the cousin is jealous and evil
